Sisk: "..."
Touya: "What's wrong?"
Sisk: "...What is the meaning of this?"
Touya: "By 'this,' do you mean this mess?"
Sisk: "Yes! I'm in charge of the Liebhofen's kitchen!
Is this a challenge to me?! Well, is it?!"
Touya: "Look, don't ask me..."
Sisk: "What do they think this sacred kitchen is for...?"
Yamato: 'She looks upset. We'd better stay out of her way, meow.'
Touya: 'Yeah...'
Sisk: "Honestly... Grumble, grumble, grumble..."
Touya: "W-Well, see you..."
Yamato: "Oh, Ymir."
Ymir: "Huh? O-Oh... What's the matter? Did you need me?"
Touya: "Well, uh... Not for anything in particular..."
Yamato: "Whoa?! Y-Ymir!"
Touya: "H-Hey, are you all right?"
Yamato: "The infirmary's just downstairs. Let's carry her there!"
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Gabon: "...Honestly, after all the times I told her
not to push herself..."
Touya: "How is she? Is she sick or something?"
Gabon: "No, it's exhaustion."
Touya: "Oh, I see..."
Gabon: "But it's not as reassuring a situation
as you seem to think."
Touya: "What do you mean?"
Yamato: "Hey, remember the Adjuster?"
Touya: "Yeah, that stuff they injected into me and everyone else, right?"
Yamato: "Right. It's not just a translator, meow.
It supports your body's functions.
When you're hurt, it eases the pain
and helps the injured area heal..."
Touya: "...So it can keep you healthy
through minor problems?"
Gabon: "That's right. And yet Ymir collapsed.
You know what that means, don't you?"
Touya: "Don't tell me..."
Gabon: "..."
Touya: "H-Hey, seriously?! You're kidding, right?!"
Gabon: "...Heh... Hahahahaha!
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:02><FC:02:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:F0> Don't worry so much. She'll recover just fine if she rests."
Touya: "D-Don't scare me like that..."
Gabon: "Sorry, sorry.
But it really is dangerous to keep doing this.
That girl never learns. Honestly."
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "Hey, let's leave this to Gabon."
Touya: "...Yeah. I'm counting on you, then."
Gabon: "Yeah, leave her to me."
Touya: "Hey."
Celica: "Oh, Touya. What's up?"
Touya: "Hm? Well, I don't really need anything."
Celica: "Hmm. Then I assign you the mission of keeping this seat warm
in my place."
Touya: "Huh?"
Celica: "You're free, aren't you?"
Touya: "I'm not that free. See you!"
Celica: "Oh..."
Celica: "Are you wandering around looking for someone new to meet?"
Touya: "Of course not."
Celica: "You're right. Touya, you're not really the type
to go looking for romance yourself."
Touya: "Then what type do I look like?"
Celica: "Hmm, you do something without thinking much of it,
it moves the other person's heart, and things work out before you know it,
Touya: "As if things could work out that conveniently."
Celica: "Well, you'll find out sooner or later.
All right, I should get going."
